_attribution: Hand-built, NOT a captured response: the ids and coordinates are made up (a hexagon near EDDF). The SHAPE is exactly what Overpass returns for `out body geom;`, verified live 2026-09-22 against KATL relation 10189710 ("Domestic Terminal"): a relation carries `bounds`, a `members` array whose way members each hold their own `geometry` of {lat, lon} objects, and `tags` - no top-level geometry. The outer ring is split across two ways that share both end nodes, and the second is stored in the OPPOSITE direction, so joining it needs a reversal. The inner way (a courtyard) must not become part of the outline.
